request_description: 1. Internal departmental correspondence in relation to Parliamentary question 50300/23 from Patrick Costello here (below) “Deputy Patrick Costello asked the Tánaiste and Minister for Foreign Affairs if his Department is carrying out checks at Shannon Airport on US military vehicles which are stopping off enroute to Israel and other jurisdictions; if so, the number that have taken place in the past ten years; and if he will make a statement on the matter. [50300/23]” 2. Internal departmental correspondence in relation to Parliamentary question 50512/23 from Matt Carthy here (below) “Deputy Matt Carthy asked the Tánaiste and Minister for Foreign Affairs the steps he has taken to ensure that military aircraft of foreign states landing in Ireland or overflights in sovereign Irish airspace are unarmed, carry no arms, ammunition or explosives and do not engage in intelligence gathering or form part of military exercises or operations; and whether there has been any review of the oversight of these matters in the context of the Israeli military assaults on Gaza. [50512/23]” 3. Any documents related to any consultation between the Department of Foreign Affairs and the Department of Transport and/or the Department of Justice to determine if there are foreign policy or security considerations to take into account for the five most recent requests for exemptions in respect of munitions of war as indicated by the Minister here (below) “I have addressed the wider issues relating to Ireland’s approach to the current crisis in Israel and the occupied Palestinian territory on frequent occasions over recent weeks so I will focus my response on issues relating to diplomatic clearance for military aircraft. Under the terms of the Air Navigation (Foreign Military Aircraft) Order, 1952, all foreign military aircraft wishing to overfly, or land in, the State require diplomatic clearance from the Minister for Foreign Affairs. Diplomatic clearance is subject to strict conditions, including that the aircraft is unarmed; that it carries no arms, ammunition or explosives; that it does not engage in intelligence gathering; and that the flight in question does not form part of a military exercise or operation. This policy is well known and is fully understood by the United States and other international partners, and is done in compliance with Ireland’s traditional policy of military neutrality. With regard to the transit of US military aircraft through Shannon and other Irish airports, the Department of Foreign Affairs publishes statistics in relation to overflights and landings of foreign military and state aircraft on the Department’s website. This includes details on the number of US military aircraft that have landed in Shannon airport this year. My Department is committed to the highest standards of transparency and, as such, will continue to publish details relating to overflights and landings on a monthly basis on the Department’s website, as well as working to compile and publish historic data relating to overflights and landing of foreign military aircraft where and when possible.”

This should encompass operational costs, personnel expenses, maintenance, and any other relevant expenditures associated with each individual embassy. 2. *Rental Properties*: A comprehensive report outlining the total costs related to all rental properties managed by the Department of Foreign Affairs during the indicated period. This request includes, but is not limited to, expenses associated with both domestic and international properties. 3. *Foreign Aid Expenditure*: A thorough account of the foreign aid disbursed globally by the Department from January 2022 to the present. This should include a detailed breakdown of the aid provided to various countries, specifying the amounts disbursed and the purposes for which the aid was provided. 4. *Entertainment Allowances and Expenditures*: I would also request information regarding entertainment allowances and expenditures incurred by the embassies. Specifically, I am seeking a list of those embassies that have allocated funds for entertainment, along with a comprehensive breakdown of those costs. 5. *Ministerial Office Entertainment Allowances and Expenditures*: Additionally, I would like to request a full breakdown of all entertainment allowances and expenditures from the Ministerial office during the same time frame. This should include a detailed account of expenses incurred, purposes, and any relevant justifications. I would greatly appreciate your assistance in providing this information at your earliest convenience. If my request cannot be fulfilled in its entirety, I kindly ask that you provide as much information as possible and indicate the reasons for any limitations.

That is from the commencement of construction to the certified completion. I refer to the €100,000 NGO Co- Financing Scheme donation. To clarify I request copies of all construction progress reports forwarded to the Department of Foreign Affairs & Trade along with all written and electronic communications from the Life Home Project management team. A66) Reference the Life Home Project, Phuket I request sight of the files that contain: A) The original and any subsequent funding proposals submitted by the Life Home Project Phuket to Irish Aid. B) The amount requested and finally approved, C) The necessary planning permission application and building approval certificates. D) The acknowledgments for all financial disbursements received by the Life Home Project amounting to €100,000 The architectural certification that the work was carried out in accordance with all building and zoning codes.. A67) I request sight of the files confirming that all payments amounting to €100K transferred directly into a bank account in the name of the Life Home Project? A68) I request sight of the files detailing how: A) The sum of €100K was decided upon and by who? B) The names of the Department of Foreign Affairs & Trade & Irish Aid, officials who advocated for and approved this donation of €100K C) The documentation furnished by the Life Home Project to support the request and receipt for this sum of €100K? A69) I request sight of the files detailing additional donations or payments made to the Life Home Project by the Department of Foreign Affairs & Trade – Irish Aid from 2004 to 2018? including contributions made for fund raising activities. A70) I request sight of the file comprising the signed ‘Contract’ forwarded to Ms. Tracy Thompson, Civil Society Development Cooperation Ireland by Ms. Helene Fallon Wood on behalf of the Life Home Project. A71) I request sight of the files containing all proforma construction estimates tendered by the Life Home Project prior to the Irish Aid donation of €100K and the name of the Contractor and the company that carried out the construction work to include copies of all cheques made payable to and cashed by either the Life Home Project or the contractor and sub-contractors. A72) I request sight of the file containing a copy of the final signing off by the Contractor, the Life Home Project administrators and the appointed architect on completion of the construction. A73) I request sight of the files containing the architectural drawings submitted to the Phuket Provincial Land Office, by the Life Home Project and the certified approval from the Land Office. Also requested is a copy of the planning and construction approval issued by the Phuket Land Office AND the adjusted Title Deed (CHANOTE). A74) I request sight of the files that contain the A) approval B) validation and C) the signing off, for the disbursement of the €100K by Irish Aid to the Life Home Project that is: The Minister for Foreign Affairs and Trade. The Secretary General of the Department of Foreign Affairs. The Public Accounts Committee. The Comptroller and Auditor General. The Audit Committee. F) Department of Public Expenditure and Reform. A75) I request sight of the file detailing the due diligence investigations carried out by the DFA & Trade - Irish Aid on the directors of the Life Home Project, prior to this donation of €100K. A76) I request sight of the file containing the audited approval from the Controller & Auditor General regarding the donation of €100K to the Life Home Project and his assurance that public these funds were properly managed and disbursed to good effect.
